/reports/sources.descriptionEn: Every employment assignment, past and present, with contract dates, probation and pay.

/reports/sources.descriptionEn: Organisation units with company, branch, parent, head and current headcount.

/reports/templates.name: Absence Report
/reports/templates.description: Absences in the last 30 days.

/reports/templates.name: Attendance Exceptions
/reports/templates.description: Every day in the last 30 days that is not a clean attendance: late, half day, absent or missing a punch.

/reports/templates.name: Attendance Report
/reports/templates.description: Daily attendance for the last 30 days with late, early-leave and overtime minutes.

/reports/templates.name: Contract Expiry Report
/reports/templates.description: Current contracts ending within the next 60 days.

/reports/templates.name: Daily Attendance
/reports/templates.description: Today's attendance by company, project and site: status, times and worked minutes.

/reports/templates.name: Deductions by Employee
/reports/templates.description: What was deducted from each employee in a payroll period, and for what. Deductions are a payroll figure, not an attendance one - this is the companion to the timesheet.

/reports/templates.name: Device Synchronization Report
/reports/templates.description: Commands sent to devices in the last 30 days and their outcome.

/reports/templates.name: Device Transactions
/reports/templates.description: Punches received from devices in the last 7 days, as the devices sent them.

/reports/templates.name: Early Departures
/reports/templates.description: Days with early departure in the last 30 days.

/reports/templates.name: Employee Device Assignment
/reports/templates.description: Who is assigned to which device, synchronised, present and enrolled.

/reports/templates.name: Employee Document Expiry Report
/reports/templates.description: Any identification document expiring in the next 120 days, soonest first.

/reports/templates.name: Employee List by Department
/reports/templates.description: Active employees grouped by department with a headcount per department.

/reports/templates.name: Employee List by Nationality
/reports/templates.description: Headcount by nationality, with the employees under each.

/reports/templates.name: Employee Master Report
/reports/templates.description: Every employee with personal, identification, contact and assignment details.

/reports/templates.name: Employee Separation Report
/reports/templates.description: Employees who resigned or were terminated.

/reports/templates.name: Employees by Position
/reports/templates.description: Who holds which position, grouped by job title.

/reports/templates.name: Failed Synchronizations
/reports/templates.description: Commands that failed in the last 30 days, with the device's answer.

/reports/templates.name: Iqama / Passport Expiry Report
/reports/templates.description: Employees whose Iqama or passport expires within the next 90 days.

/reports/templates.name: Late Arrivals
/reports/templates.description: Days with late arrival in the last 30 days, grouped by employee.

/reports/templates.name: Leave Balance Report
/reports/templates.description: Entitled, used and remaining days per employee and leave type for the current year.

/reports/templates.name: Leave Transactions Report
/reports/templates.description: Leave requests in the last 90 days with their decision.

/reports/templates.name: Missing Punches
/reports/templates.description: Days with only a check-in or only a check-out in the last 30 days.

/reports/templates.name: Monthly Attendance
/reports/templates.description: This month per employee: days by status, worked, late, early-leave and overtime minutes.

/reports/templates.name: New Joiners Report
/reports/templates.description: Employees hired in the last 90 days.

/reports/templates.name: Overtime Report
/reports/templates.description: Overtime this month per employee, after the rule set's minimum and rounding.

/reports/templates.name: Payroll Summary
/reports/templates.description: Basic, gross, deductions and net per payslip, grouped by period.

/reports/templates.name: Recruitment Status Report
/reports/templates.description: Applications by stage with candidate, requisition and dates.

/reports/templates.name: Salary Components Report
/reports/templates.description: Earnings and deductions by component across payslips.

/reports/templates.name: Timesheet by Employee
/reports/templates.description: Each employee's days in a period: in, out, worked, overtime and the trade, with a total per employee.

/reports/templates.name: Timesheet by Trade
/reports/templates.description: The same days grouped by trade then employee: how many carpenter, labour or steel-fixer hours a period took.
